name: set_bits_and_queue_blit

name: init_state_from_helper_result
description: Calls a helper with fixed arguments, stores its result offset into two globals, then clears three globals and sets one.

name: clear_two_record_tables
description: Zeroes the first word of 128 twenty-byte records and of eight eighteen-byte records, then calls a helper.

name: call_two_helpers_in_order
description: Calls one system routine and then a helper, in that order, with no other logic.

name: forward_to_helper_routine
description: Calls one helper routine and returns, adding no logic of its own.

name: store_offset_character_and_call
description: Writes a character derived from the high byte of its argument, offset by the at-sign code, into a shared global, then calls a helper.

name: forward_to_helper_routine
description: Reassigns a shared global to its own value and calls a helper; the self-assignment has no effect.

name: forward_to_helper_routine
description: Reassigns a shared global to its own value and calls a helper; the self-assignment has no effect.

name: store_argument_and_call_helper
description: Stores its argument into a shared global and then calls a helper routine.

name: run_long_setup_sequence
description: When a shared value is set, runs a long setup sequence: it calls system routines with fixed arguments, clears several shared values, and fills a run of stack-held parameters before further steps.

name: stub_no_operation
description: Empty routine that only returns; it does no work.

name: store_helper_result_for_block
description: Calls a helper with a fixed address and size argument and stores the result in a shared global.

name: set_base_offset_call_twice
description: Resets a shared global, offsets it by a fixed base amount, and calls two helpers.

name: fill_eight_byte_descriptor_records
description: Fills 150 eight-byte descriptor records with fixed width and height values and an address that steps by 640 bytes per record.

name: fill_small_descriptor_records
description: Fills 80 eight-byte descriptor records with fixed width and height values and an address that steps by 160 bytes per record.

name: scan_records_for_matching_flag
description: Initialises a counter from a fixed address, then scans records in a loop, comparing a word with the counter and checking a flag bit in each matching record.

name: enable_vertical_blank_interrupt
description: Writes a handler address and sets the vertical-blank interrupt enable bit, then clears the shared value.

name: acknowledge_vertical_blank_request
description: If the vertical-blank request bit is set, counts the interrupt and returns when a related flag is set; otherwise it writes the vertical-blank acknowledge bit.

name: store_pair_entry_and_adjust
description: Advances a shared value, calls a helper, stores its result as a longword followed by a fixed constant word, and steps the shared value back.

name: build_display_copper_list
description: Builds a copper list in memory: writes a fixed set of display control register moves, then a loop of colour and wait entries for each display line.

name: halt_in_endless_loop
description: Spins forever without returning, marking a halt point that the caller never leaves in this copy.

name: merge_shifted_bitplane_bytes
description: Computes a byte offset from a column and row, then copies and merges bytes from several source rows into the destination plane, shifting each by the column bit offset.

name: merge_shifted_bitplane_bytes
description: Performs the same shifted bitplane byte merge as its neighbouring entry, starting from a different point in the loop.

name: merge_shifted_bitplane_longs
description: Computes an offset from a column and row, then merges shifted 32-bit words from several planes into the destination, using the same plane stride as the byte variants.

name: copy_bitplane_rows_block
description: Copies rows of four-longword blocks between two buffers, with the column offset taken from the position value and repeated over the row count.

name: invert_or_of_five_planes
description: Writes the inverse of the OR of five 5000-longword source planes into a sixth plane, one longword at a time.

name: clear_record_field_word
description: Clears a 16-bit field at offset ten of the record addressed by the address register.

name: initialise_runtime_globals
description: Zeroes a block of shared globals and sets a few defaults, including a count of five and a state of four.

name: forward_to_helper_routine
description: Calls one helper routine and returns, adding no logic of its own.

name: store_indexed_table_entry
description: Stores a helper result into a 12-byte-stride table slot selected by its argument, then calls helpers and, when a stored value differs, recomputes a pointer from the table.

name: call_helper_return_tagged_value
description: Calls a helper and returns its result with a fixed marker value combined into the high bits.

name: forward_helper_result
description: Calls one helper and passes its return value straight back.

name: run_helper_with_flag_set
description: Sets a shared flag to one, calls a helper, then clears the flag.

name: adjust_counters_and_round_even
description: Adjusts two shared counters by the argument, rounds the second up to an even value when the first stays non-negative, and spins forever if the first goes negative.

name: initialise_counter_pair_and_call
description: Sets two shared counters to fixed starting values and calls a helper.

name: clear_memory_block
description: Zeroes a block of 357768 bytes starting at a fixed address.

name: read_joystick_direction_and_buttons
description: Reads the joystick movement and button registers, combines the movement bits into a direction code, looks up the direction value from a table, and stores the button state.

name: unpack_run_length_block
description: Decodes a run-length packed block: a negative count repeats one copied byte, a positive count copies literal bytes, and the output is written to the destination.

name: find_table_match_and_copy
description: Searches a table of four-longword entries for one matching the given key, then calls helpers and copies the matched entry's data into the output buffer.

name: run_init_helpers_unless_tagged
description: Calls a sequence of helpers unless a four-byte tag at a fixed address reads as the text DIR followed by a zero byte, then returns zero.

name: find_trackdisk_device_unit
description: Looks up the trackdisk device by name through the system's name-search call and, when found, fills in a unit field of the device record.

name: configure_disk_read_dma
description: Configures disk DMA for a track read by setting the sync word, the disk length and pointer, and the ADK control, then calls helpers to start it.

name: decode_raw_track_sectors
description: Scans a raw track for sync words, decodes the odd and even bit fields of each sector into a buffer across ten sectors, and halts when a decoded value fails verification.

name: deselect_drive_after_delay
description: Calls a helper, writes a fixed drive-control value to the CIA-B port, waits through a fixed delay loop, stores a value into a record, and clears a flag bit.

name: select_drive_control_value
description: Writes one of two fixed drive-control values to a CIA-B port depending on whether the input is zero, then calls a helper.

name: write_fixed_cia_b_value
description: Writes one fixed control value to the CIA-B port register.

name: poll_until_drive_ready_clear
description: Repeatedly sets the low port bits to a drive-select pattern and calls a helper while a status bit remains set, then clears the port value.

name: wait_while_status_bit_set
description: Busy-waits while a status bit in the shared byte remains set, then returns.

name: copy_record_table_block
description: Copies 80 seven-longword records from a source table to a destination block.

name: seek_drive_head_to_target
description: Writes a fixed interrupt-enable mask, then steps the drive head one position at a time toward the target track while setting the direction bit.

name: configure_cia_b_timer
description: Writes a fixed interrupt-enable mask, sets the CIA-B timer registers with control and timer load values, then clears a shared value.

name: find_table_match_or_halt
description: Searches a table of four-longword entries for one matching the given key, then calls a helper; if no entry matches it halts in an endless loop.

name: copy_init_data_block
description: Sets a state value, calls a system routine with fixed arguments, copies a large block of initial data from a source table into memory, then runs further setup calls.

name: copy_rectangular_bitplane_block
description: Copies a rectangular block of bytes row by row between two buffers, using the width and height passed in registers across three nested loops.

name: wait_for_status_bit_transition
description: Waits until a status bit clears and then until it sets again, pausing on that single transition.

name: run_setup_steps_with_arg
description: Calls three helpers in order, then calls a fourth helper with the argument 160.

name: call_three_helpers_in_order
description: Calls three helpers in order, with no other logic.

name: store_offset_pointer_table_a
description: Stores the shared value and derived offsets into a set of pointer slots with fixed constants, then calls two helpers.

name: store_offset_pointer_table_b
description: Stores the shared value and derived offsets into a different set of pointer slots, adjusting one value to be even, then calls two helpers.

name: install_handler_pointer_table
description: Writes a long list of pointer slots to the shared address, configures the CIA-B timer and interrupt registers, and calls six helpers.

name: set_control_bits_and_return
description: Writes a shared control value and two fixed values to the port globals, then returns the input byte with bits four to six set.

name: expand_nibble_bits_to_table
description: Walks the four low bits of its argument one at a time, writing a matching entry into a shared table for each set bit, and treats a zero nibble as all four bits set.

name: search_table_for_match
description: Walks a table in steps of three shorts until it finds an entry equal to the given value or a zero terminator, then returns.

name: process_unrecovered_routine_body
description: Routine of 49 instructions called from two places; no decompiled body was available, so its behaviour is not described here.

name: update_flagged_table_entries
description: Reads a 64-bit value from a helper and, for each of up to four table entries whose flag bit is set, updates that entry's fields from the matching bits, calling a helper where needed.

name: update_status_and_counter_state
description: Updates a shared status flag and a counter byte from the current state, then calls four helpers to handle the DMA and interrupt state.

name: dispatch_command_codes_loop
description: Loops over a small command code, branching on each value to update shared state or call a helper, and writes the DMA and interrupt request registers when it finishes.

name: update_state_from_table
description: Reads a byte from a structure, clears a flag, and conditionally adds a table value to a field; computes a signed difference from an input word, clamps negative results to zero, then updates counters against table bytes.

name: process_entity_state
description: Updates fields of a structure through flag bits and counters, walking byte tables to copy and increment values, and returns early when certain conditions hold.

name: silence_audio_channel_volume
description: Writes zero to the volume register of an audio channel selected by the argument, and sets a shared mask to the bit for that channel.
